sourceTitle: Why Nobody Can Afford a House Anymore
title: A House Used To Cost 2 Years Of Income
hook: A house once cost two years of income. Not anymore.
question: What's the ratio where you live?

scenes.narration: A house used to cost about two years of income. That math is gone.
In nineteen seventy, the typical home cost roughly two years of the typical income. Today it is closer to six.
scenes.kicker: Years of income to buy the typical home
scenes.sub: the typical home vs a typical year's pay

scenes.narration: The median American home now runs about four hundred twelve thousand dollars.
scenes.label: and still climbing
